title: 收货入库完整性核对
context: 库存＋采购联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 比较每条合格收货记录与库存流水入库数量，包含拒收全部的记录；输出采购行、收货编号、应入库及已入库差额；仅差额非0。预计干净主库无差异，不能伪造异常。
commonError: 内连接会漏掉应入库但未记账的记录。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT receipt_id,SUM(quantity_delta) qty FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='receipt' GROUP BY receipt_id) SELECT g.receipt_id,g.po_item_id,g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected expected_units,COALESCE(a.qty,0) posted_units,COALESCE(a.qty,0)-(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected) difference FROM goods_receipts g LEFT JOIN a ON a.receipt_id=g.receipt_id WHERE COALESCE(a.qty,0)<>g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected ORDER BY g.receipt_id
